items.title: Hypercovering spectral sequence over a presheaf base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove the presheaf-base variant over an augmentation K -> G: choose an injective resolution F -> I^bullet and form the double complex A^{p,q} = I^q(K_p) with d_1 from the resolution and d_2 from the cosimplicial differential (roles swapped relative to the X-based lemma); lemma-injective-trivial-cech-variant makes the columns s(I^p(K)) acyclic with H^0 = H^0(G, I^p), so H^0(G, I^bullet) -> Tot(A) is a quasi-isomorphism representing RGamma(G,F), and the map s(F(K)) -> RGamma(G,F) is defined through it; the ''E spectral sequence takes cohomology in d_1 first, giving ''E_1^{p,q} = underline H^p(F)(K_q) and ''E_2^{p,q} = Cech^p(K, underline H^q(F)) converging to H^{p+q}(G,F).
